channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Türkiye welcomes ceasefire deal between Syria, SDF
item.description: Türkiye has expressed optimism regarding a new ceasefire agreement between the Syrian government and the Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF), framing the deal as a step toward "unity and integration."

item.title: Türkiye records 889,598 births in 2025
item.description: Türkiye recorded 889,598 births in 2025, with “Alya” emerging as the most popular name for baby girls and “Alparslan” remaining the top choice for boys, according to Interior Ministry data.

item.title: Size of entertainment industry expected to surpass $2 billion
item.description: Türkiye’s entertainment industry, encompassing manufacturers, operators and suppliers, currently generates an annual turnover exceeding $1.8 billion.

item.title: Europe’s auto industry can’t exclude Türkiye, says OSD head
item.description: As the European Union prepares to redefine the “Made in EU” designation in the automotive sector, the head of Türkiye’s Automotive Manufacturers Association (OSD), Cengiz Eroldu, stressed that Türkiye remains an integral part of Europe’s automotive supply chain.

item.title: Türkiye, Uzbekistan to convene quadruple strategic talks in Ankara
item.description: Türkiye and Uzbekistan will hold the fourth round of their Joint Strategic Planning Group in the Turkish capital Ankara, with the participation of their foreign, defense and interior ministers, as well as intelligence chiefs, aiming to expand cooperation in economic relations, connectivity, energy, and the defense sector.

item.title: Snow-covered streets, transit woes haunt daily life in Istanbul
item.description: A powerful barrage of heavy snow engulfed Istanbul on Jan. 19, severely disrupting its vast public and private transportation infrastructure and bringing Türkiye's most populous city to a near standstill amid heavy traffic jams and widespread delays.

item.title: Fidan discusses Gaza peace plan with Arab counterparts
item.description: Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan exchanged separate phone conversations with his counterparts from Egypt, Saudi Arabia and Jordan over recent regional developments, particularly the implementation of the second stage of the Gaza peace deal, sources have informed.

item.title: Syrian army deploys in Deir Ezzor province after landmark deal
item.description: The Syrian army on Jan. 19 deployed its forces in parts of the eastern Deir Ezzor province and moved to take control of the Tishrin Dam southeast of Manbij, with President Ahmad al-Sharaa hailing the “victory for all” after a deal and ceasefire with the Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF).

item.title: EU says 'priority is to engage not escalate' after Trump tariff threat
item.description: The EU said on Monday it wanted to engage with the United States after President Donald Trump threatened tariffs on European countries in the standoff over Greenland, but was ready to act if needed.

item.title: Terror era in region ended: Erdoğan
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan said on Monday that “the era of terrorism in our region has come to an end,” warning that all parties must fully implement ceasefire and integration agreements and avoid renewed miscalculations.
